notes.title: Russian translation
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I’m just posting a quick update to let you know that I’ve uploaded a new build of Dreamy Planet! This build features a full Russian translation, thanks to Mikhail "KornyPony" Burov-Kosolapin. His work is appreciated: it’s fun seeing my VNs in more new languages!

I also updated the English script to fix a couple of minor typos, though that isn’t very exciting.

As always, if you find more typos or errors with the game (specifically in regards to Steam achievements), please let me know. I’ll try to fix everything as fast as is reasonably possible!

- ebi x
